cards.name: Infallible Aim
cards.text: Your weapon gets +3 damage until the end of this turn. If your bullet track level is 3, your weapon gets +5 damage instead.
cards.it: La tua weapon ottiene +3 danni fino a fine turno; se il tracciato bullet e' a 3, ne ottiene +5.

cards.name: Prompt Answer
cards.text: When a behavior card is revealed, you may discard this card from your hand to reload 2.
cards.it: Quando viene rivelata una behavior, puoi scartarla dalla mano per fare reload 2.

cards.name: Camouflage
cards.text: Stealth.
cards.it: Stealth.

cards.name: Swift Reload
cards.text: Assist. Reload 1. If you have another parry in your sequence, reload 2 instead.
cards.it: Assist. Reload 1; se hai un altro parry in sequenza, reload 2.

cards.name: Explosive Shot
cards.text: Remove 1 struggle. You may spend 2 bullets. If you do, this attack inflicts vulnerable.
cards.it: Rimuovi 1 struggle. Puoi spendere 2 bullet: se lo fai, questo attacco infligge vulnerable.

cards.name: Counter Measure
cards.text: Assist. If you avoid attrition damage this turn, search your discard pile for up to 2 cards of your choice and add them to your hand.
cards.it: Assist. Se eviti il danno da attrition in questo turno, cerca fino a 2 carte negli scarti e aggiungile alla mano.
